fields.quoted_span:
It is unlawful for a person to sell, license, or otherwise provide an

                  algorithmic device to a landlord.
fields.note: Requirement matches §98.1103(a), (b), the algorithmic device definition, separate-violation language, tenant remedies and attorney's fees, and cumulative remedies. Minor nit: the summary says 'any person' and 'San Diego' property; the text supports both.

fields.quoted_span:
A tenant may seek injunctive relief, damages, or civil penalties of up to

                        $1,000 per violation of this Division, in a civil action against a landlord.
fields.note: The $1,000 cap, separate monthly/per-property violations, prevailing-tenant fees and costs, and the 30th-day effective timing are all in the document. The 'civil penalties' are sought by tenants in civil actions, not imposed by the city, but the wording is consistent.

The effective_date field is empty. The document gives only a relative formula (30th day after final passage) and leaves the passage date blank, so no absolute date is stated. The rule's formula and note are consistent with this.

fields.quoted_span:
I certify that the Council of the City of San Diego adopted this Ordinance at a meeting held on
______________________________.
fields.note: The document is a proposed draft with blank number, passage date and adoption certification. The staff report describes it as 'proposed'. 'Pending' is consistent with this.

fields.quoted_span:
Residential rental property has the same meaning as in San Diego Municipal

           Code section 98.0702, as may be amended.
fields.note: The text defines landlord and residential rental property by reference to §98.0702 and limits the algorithmic device definition to property in the City of San Diego. The document does not state unit-count, construction-date or landlord-size limits. The claim that the mobilehome park inclusion and the §98.0703 exemptions are not incorporated depends on content of §98.0702/§98.0703 that is not in this document; the document itself neither incorporates the exemptions nor states them.

fields.quoted_span: §98.1103   Use and Sale of Algorithmic Devices Prohibited
fields.note: Section 98.1103 is correct. Aliases (ch. 9, art. 8, div. 11; §§98.1101-98.1104; O-2025-107; the ordinance title) all appear in the document.
